description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Revocation of order under the Industrial Disputes Act that published on the Ex. Ord. Gaz. No. 1960/12 of 29.03.2016 and the appointment of Mr. T. E. Santharajan as the arbitrator to the Industrial Dispute between Group of employees including Anoma Kumari & Central Cultural Fund
reasoning: This gazette content primarily deals with legal/regulatory matters under the Industrial Disputes Act, specifically the revocation and issuance of orders for arbitration proceedings in an industrial dispute. It involves statutory instruments (orders under Section 4(1) of the Act) and legal procedures for dispute resolution, which falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it mentions a minister's name, it does not constitute a government personnel appointment or structural change, but rather represents the minister exercising statutory powers in a legal/regulatory capacity.
